_meta.description: Synthetic personal-companion memory for the Phase 1 Step 1.4b golden eval set. Seeded into a fresh tmp SQLite DB by eval/run_eval.py::bootstrap_pipeline() on every run. One small recurring cast (Priya, Sam, Marcus, Dana) across a product launch, a Portugal trip, a house move, a book club, and everyday life. Every fact a golden item asks about is traceable to a message or a structured record here.
_meta.session_metadata_note: Each session carries a canned `metadata` block (topics/action_types/entities/sentiment/confidence). bootstrap_pipeline() monkeypatches src.ingestion.metadata_extractor.simple_generate to return json.dumps(session['metadata']) so ingestion is deterministic and needs no Ollama.

messages.content: we need to sort out the launch date. marketing isn't ready for Wednesday.
What day works instead?
let's move the launch to Friday. that gives marketing two more days.
Okay, launch is Friday. Anything else blocking?
Priya is going to own the launch checklist. she'll chase down the remaining items.
Got it — Priya owns the checklist, launch moved to Friday.
and the launch budget stays capped at 5000 dollars, no extra spend without asking me.
Understood. $5000 cap, launch Friday, Priya on the checklist.
planning the Portugal trip. we should leave Saturday morning so we beat the traffic.
Saturday morning it is. Where are you flying from?
Lisbon direct. Sam is booking the hotel, he found one near the old town.
Nice. So Sam handles the hotel. What about the rental car?
we'll pick that up at the airport. also I want to bring the tent in case we do a night on the coast.
Tent for a coast night, got it. Total budget for the trip?
I don't want to go over 1200 for the whole thing, flights included.
Under $1200 all-in, leave Saturday morning, Sam on the hotel, bringing the tent.
the movers are confirmed for the 15th, they arrive at 8am.
Movers on the 15th at 8am. Are you packed?
mostly. Dana is coming over the weekend before to help me pack the kitchen, that's the part I'm dreading.
Dana takes the kitchen. Anything fragile they should know about?
the record player. I'll carry that one myself in the car.
You carry the record player. Movers 8am on the 15th, Dana helps with the kitchen the weekend before.
book club picked the next book. we're reading Project Hail Mary.
Good pick. When's the discussion?
Thursday evening at Marcus's place, 7pm. I need to be about halfway through by then.
Thursday 7pm at Marcus's, aim for halfway through Project Hail Mary.
had my 1:1 today. I told my manager I want to move to the payments team.
How did that land?
not a no, but not now. she said revisit it in Q2 once the current project ships.
So the door's open, just timed for Q2 after the project ships.
right. Priya already switched to payments last year so I asked her what it's like, she said it's more on-call but more interesting work.
Revisit the move in Q2; Priya says payments is more on-call but more interesting.
I'm overdue for my annual dental cleaning. need to book with Dr. Okafor.
Want me to remind you to call?
yeah. and the cleaning itself, whenever they slot me in, put it on the calendar.
I'll remind you to call Dr. Okafor, and add the cleaning once it's scheduled.
the car is making that grinding noise again when I brake. it needs new brake pads.
Do you have a quote?
the shop said about 400 dollars for the front pads and rotors. I'm dropping it off Monday morning.
$400 for front pads and rotors, dropping the car off Monday morning.
I want to try making pesto pasta from scratch this weekend.
What do you need?
fresh basil and pine nuts, I have the rest. add those to my shopping list.
Added basil and pine nuts to your list for the pesto pasta.
morning! how are you today?
Doing well, thanks. Ready when you are.
just saying hi, nothing I need right now.
Anytime. Have a good one.
Sam's birthday is March 3rd and I have no idea what to get him.
What's he been into lately?
he's been getting into photography. maybe a starter camera, or a nice lens if he already has a body.
A starter camera or a lens for Sam, birthday March 3rd.
